Name: TP's Faust Portrait
Author: Tampey
Description:
This is [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/37246]Custom NPC Faust[/url] Portrait.
i made it drawing .  Thank you [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/profile/SukuroIsUseless]SukuroIsUseless[/url] for making Faust :)

[u][b]These download files don't have a manifast.json file. You have to find and add the path file yourself.[/b][/u]


How to install

[list]
[*]If you don't already have them, download the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/999]Portraiture[/url]﻿ mod and [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24534]PortraiturePlus[/url]﻿ mod
[*]Download this mod.
[*]Mods/Portraiture/Portraits and create a new folder.
[*]Put the portraits from this mod into the new folder.
[/list]


If you have any problems with this file, please let me know. Feedback is welcome :)
